name: chrome-profile-names
description: Show your Chrome profile names (Home, Work) instead of 'Browser 1' and device IDs when Claude in Chrome asks which browser to use.

hideRemote.description: Hide browsers that aren't paired in any Chrome profile on this machine, since they're on another computer. If the mod can't match any of the listed browsers to a profile here, it hides nothing, so a browser it failed to recognize still shows up.
hideRemote.title: Hide browsers on other machines
